name: Speechify
tagline: Speechify is a text-to-speech app that converts any text — web pages, PDFs, emails, books — into natural-sounding audio you can listen to at up to 4.5× normal reading speed. Its AI voice cloning feature lets users create a personal AI voice that reads content in their own voice. Students, professionals with dyslexia, and busy commuters use Speechify to consume written content faster than reading allows.
